title: Called Into the Light
story:
A village experienced a long power outage one stormy night.

The streets were dark.

People stayed inside their homes.

A little boy held a flashlight as he waited by the window.

After several hours, the electricity suddenly returned.

Lights filled every house.

The streets became bright again.

The boy smiled and ran outside.

Everything that had been hidden in the darkness was now easy to see.

His grandfather walked beside him and said,

“Light changes everything.

It helps us see where to walk and reminds us there is nothing to fear.”

In life, sin keeps us in darkness.

But God did not leave us there.

Through Jesus, He called us into His wonderful light.

Now we belong to Him.

And our lives are meant to reflect His goodness wherever we go.
life_lesson: God has called you out of darkness into His wonderful light so you can live as His chosen child.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for calling me into Your marvelous light.

Thank You for making me part of Your family.

Help me to leave the darkness behind and live each day in a way that honors You.

May my life reflect Your love and goodness to others.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
What darkness has God brought you out of?

How can your life reflect His light to those around you today?

Who needs to see God's light through your actions?
verse: But you are a chosen people, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, God's special possession, that you may declare the praises of Him who called you out of darkness into His wonderful light.
